overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: topics discussed at the Aug. 13, 2012 meeting, including the Master Plan Committee appointments, were not reasonably anticipated by the chair 48 hours before the meeting. The AG only recommended best practices, with no order.

allegations.summary: Board discussed and voted on appointing two representatives to a multi-town Master Plan Committee, a topic not specifically listed on the Aug. 13, 2012 notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Assistant Town Manager learned on the day of the meeting that the Town needed to appoint representatives to the Master Plan Committee, the Chair could not have reasonably anticipated this topic 48 hours before the meeting.

allegations.summary: Board discussed multiple Town Manager follow-up matters (recycling, Harbormaster, Truro agenda) not listed on the notice beyond the generic 'Town Manager follow-up' item.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, we have not been presented with any evidence that the matters discussed during "Town Manager Follow-up" were anticipated by the Chair 48 hours before the meeting.
